token_design_thinking.tech_design: Multi-VM (EVM + WASM), Substrate, dApp staking contract
token_design_thinking.power_structures: Community governance through dApp staking, Astar Foundation stewardship
token_design_thinking.team: Astar Foundation, distributed developers

tokenomics.emissions: 60 ASTR per block initially, declining over 2 years
